description: Implementation of hash-based key-value mappings including hash functions, table management, and string interning.

methods.name: strhash
methods.description: Computes hash for a string using FNV-1a algorithm.

methods.name: strihash
methods.description: Computes case-insensitive hash for a string.

methods.name: memhash
methods.description: Computes hash for a memory buffer.

methods.name: memihash
methods.description: Computes case-insensitive hash for a memory buffer.

methods.name: hashmap_init
methods.description: Initializes a hashmap with optional comparison function and initial size.

methods.name: hashmap_add
methods.description: Adds an entry to the hashmap.

methods.name: hashmap_remove
methods.description: Removes an entry from the hashmap.

methods.name: hashmap_get
methods.description: Retrieves an entry from the hashmap.

methods.name: hashmap_put
methods.description: Replaces or adds an entry in the hashmap.

methods.name: hashmap_iter_init
methods.description: Initializes an iterator for the hashmap.

methods.name: hashmap_iter_next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next entry.
